Ex-Man United coach Michael Carrick has penned a heartfelt and emotional letter to Manchester United supporters, reflecting on his time leading the club, expressing gratitude to the fans, and reaffirming his everlasting love for the Red Devils. As reported by Fabrizio Romano on X on Friday, in his message, Carrick described leading Manchester United as an immense privilege, admitting that managing the club he loves comes with a responsibility unlike any other. “I’ve had the immense privilege of leading Manchester United, the football club that I love,” Carrick wrote. “There are very few who get to live that and feel it, and for that I’m incredibly grateful.” The former United midfielder also highlighted the importance of the club’s identity, history, culture and traditions, insisting that representing Manchester United requires a deep understanding of what the institution stands for. “Ultimately, you need to push to be the best, but there is a culture, there are values and there are behaviours that you have to live by and respect, which have been built over a long period of time,” he said. “It’s a football club that is unique, with substance and history that cannot be ignored. This is what inspired me every single day.” Carrick reserved special praise for the supporters, describing them as a rare and special group whose passion and loyalty have continued to inspire him, even during difficult moments. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources “I want to say a big thank you to the supporters. I must say, you are a special, rare breed,” he wrote. Reflecting on the memorable moments shared with the fans, he said one of the greatest rewards of his time in charge was witnessing their emotions and excitement after important occasions. “The best thing about being in my position was seeing so many of you lose yourselves in the emotion of those moments, leaving the stadium desperate to come back again next time.” Despite acknowledging the team’s recent struggles, Carrick expressed deep appreciation for the unwavering support shown by the fans. 685 matches, three trophies: Pochettino’s record before Man United Man United appoint Pochettino new head coach EPL: Fernandes rejects second Man United contract offer “I know we’ve not had the results lately, but you’ve shown me nothing but love and support in times when the easiest thing, and what most end up doing, would be to turn the other way.” He added a powerful message that captured the relationship between the club and its supporters: “That means more than a win or two. That’s what makes you who you are. That’s why I fell in love with this club all those years ago.” The Englishman also thanked his coaching staff for their loyalty, commitment and hard work, while acknowledging the contributions of the club’s behind-the-scenes personnel. “To all the staff behind the scenes, thank you for everything you do for this football club. So much of your work goes unseen, but it never goes unappreciated,” he said. He also had words of appreciation for the players, thanking them for their efforts and the memories they created together while wishing them success in the future. Concluding his emotional message, Carrick made it clear that his connection with Manchester United would remain forever, regardless of his role at the club. “I want nothing but success for Manchester United. This club has been such a big part of my life and that will never change.” He ended with a promise that he would continue supporting the team from the stands. “I’ll be right there with you from now on, watching from the sidelines, cheering the lads on.” For Michael Carrick, the chapter of leading Manchester United may have come to an end, but his love for the club remains unchanged.
